{{Quote|Concentrate all your fire on the nearest starship.|Yoda commanding SPHA-Ts during the Battle of Geonosis|<ref name="Attack of the Clones" />}}
The '''Self-Propelled Heavy Artillery''' ('''SPHA'''), also known as the '''Self-Propelled Heavy Artillery Turbolaser''' ('''SPHA-T''') when equipped with a [[turbolaser]] emplacement, was a modular 12-[[Limb|legged]] gun platform manufactured by [[Rothana Heavy Engineering]]. They were the largest ground based weapons used by the [[Grand Army of the Republic]] in the [[Clone Wars]]. During the [[Imperial Era]], SPHA-Ts were used by the [[Imperial Artillery Corps]] of the [[Galactic Empire]].

==Characteristics==
[[File:Spha-t_geonosis.jpg|thumb|left|250px|SPHA-Ts during the Battle of Geonosis]]
Combining the devastating firepower of a permanent [[laser cannon]] emplacement with the ability to liberally walk into battle on powerful articulated [[Limb|legs]],<ref name="Complete Locations">[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2016)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']]</ref> the Self-Propelled Heavy Artillery Turbolaser (SPHA-T),<ref name="Databank" /> also known as the Self-Propelled Heavy Artillery (SPHA),<ref name="Galactic Defense">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Defense]]''</ref> were the largest ground based weapons in the arsenal of the [[Grand Army of the Republic]] at 140.2 [[meter]]s in length.<ref name="Databank" /> It only used its twelve legs when maneuvering between firing positions; when attacking an enemy target, a SPHA-T remained motionless to give its [[gunner]]s added precision for aiming its extraordinarily heavy [[turbolaser]] beam.<ref name="Ultimate Star Wars" /> Although it took no less than 30<ref name="Databank" /> specialized<ref name="Complete Locations" /> [[clone trooper]]s to man each gun platform, they were powerful and effective enough to blast through [[starship]] [[Deflector shield|shields]] and hulls.<ref name="Databank" /> However, SPHA-Ts could only be charged up to a certain level.<ref name="Complete Locations" />

SPHA-Ts were able to provide defense for [[assault ship]]s that were landing and devastating direct firepower.<ref name="Complete Vehicles 2018">[[Star Wars: Complete Vehicles (2018)|''Star Wars: Complete Vehicles'' (2018)]]</ref> The artillery [[walker]]s were generally deployed in [[squadron]]s of four and were usually placed behind advancing walkers like the [[All Terrain Tactical Enforcer]].<ref name="Altaya">{{EncyclopediaCite|Explosives, Heavy Weapons, and Power Sources}}</ref> Aboard [[Acclamator-class transgalactic military assault ship|''Acclamator''-class transgalactic military assault ships]], SPHA-Ts were stored behind All Terrain Tactical Enforcer walkers, which were at the front of bays. During the [[Clone Wars]], thanks to [[Jedi General]] [[Anakin Skywalker]], some [[Venator-class Star Destroyer|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]] had additional Self-Propelled Heavy Artillery [[cannon]]s located at their ventral docking bay. These laser cannons increased ventral firepower.<ref name="Complete Vehicles 2018" />

==History==
[[File:SPHAT-concentratedfire.png|thumb|right|250px|Several SPHA-Ts focus fire on a fleeing core ship]]
Manufactured by [[Rothana Heavy Engineering]],<ref name="Ultimate Star Wars" /> 100 SPHA-Ts were deployed in key positions on several battlefronts during the [[First Battle of Geonosis]],<ref name="Complete Locations" /> the opening battle of the Clone Wars.<ref name="Attack of the Clones" /> They were deployed in squads of four at the rear of advancing All Terrain Tactical Enforcers, while [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/carrier]]s ensured they were well defended by AT-TEs and infantry on foot, who were mobilized around and in front of SPHA-Ts to a distance of several [[kilometer]]s.<ref name="Complete Locations" /> The SPHA-Ts carried coordinating actions with [[infantry]] and the AT-TEs<ref name="Altaya" /> to provide an impregnable line of defense for the [[Republic Navy|fleet]] of ''Acclamator''-class transgalactic military assault ships that landed immediately outside the [[Petranaki Arena]], which supplied an assembly point for the deadly juggernauts.<ref name="Complete Locations" />

During the battle, they proved particularly effective on the battlefield commanded by [[Jedi Master]] [[Yoda]],<ref name="Complete Locations" /> and [[Unidentified SPHA-T squadron|one squadron]] was ordered by Master Yoda to focus fire upon a fleeing [[core ship]].<ref name="Attack of the Clones" /> This caused antigrav [[repulsorlift]] malfunctions that grated a [[tractor beam]] effect with the ground, greatly accelerating its fall<ref name="Complete Locations" /> and destroying the ship.<ref name="Attack of the Clones" /> However, after these shots, the SPHA-Ts had to be replaced with charged guns from the rear lines.<ref name="Complete Locations" />

[[File:VenatorHangarTurbolaser.png|thumb|left|300px|A SPHA-T located aboard a ''Venator'' fires upon a ''Munificent'' frigate]]
During the [[Battle of Coruscant]], a SPHA-T located in the hangar of a ''Venator''-class [[Star Destroyer]] fired upon a [[Munificent-class star frigate|''Munificent''-class star frigate]]<ref name="SPHA-T card">{{Armada|set=Venator-class Star Destroyer Expansion Pack|cardname=SPHA-T}}</ref> and took the enemy ship out as Skywalker and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]] passed it.<ref name="Episode III">{{Film|III}}</ref> After the Clone Wars and the [[Proclamation of the New Order|rise]] of the [[Galactic Empire]], the [[Imperial Army]]'s [[Imperial Artillery Corps]] used the SPHA-Ts as mobile artillery.<ref name="Dawn" /> The SPHA-Ts were eventually replaced by the smaller and faster [[SPMA]]s.<ref name="Starfighters" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|They are in ''Attack of the Clones''. They just look a little different. I had them redesigned to look a little more ''Godzilla-like'' for our purpose.|[[Dave Filoni]] clarifies the connection between the stun cannon tank and the SPHA-T|<ref name="Attack of the Zillo Beast">[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars The Complete Season Two|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' The Complete Season Two]]—Behind the Story: ''Attack of the Zillo Beast''</ref>}}
Originally created for the [[2002]] film [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']],<ref name="Attack of the Clones" /> the Self-Propelled Heavy Artillery was designed in concept sketches by Concept Design Supervisor [[Erik Tiemens]]. His initial concepts had the self-propelled cannon be mounted on treads, but [[George Lucas]] instead suggested that it be a walker like its AT-TE cousin. During production, the SPHA-T was called "Clone Tank A."<ref name="SPHA DB">{{DB|vehicle|sphat|Self Propelled Heavy Artillery - Turbolaser (SPHA-T walker)}}</ref> An early animatic featured SPHA-Ts being deployed from ''Acclamator''-class assault ships on Geonosis,<ref name="DVD commentaries">{{Film|II}} DVD commentaries</ref> though this scene was cut from the final film.<ref name="Attack of the Clones" />

The [[RX-200 Falchion-class assault tank|RX-200 ''Falchion''-class assault tank]] featured in "[[The Zillo Beast]]" and "[[The Zillo Beast Strikes Back]]" was redesigned from the SPHA-T to better resemble the maser tanks from the [[Wikipedia:Godzilla (franchise)|''Godzilla'']] franchise.<ref name="Attack of the Zillo Beast" />

The 140.2 meter databank size does not visually correlate with the physical appearances in ''Attack of the Clones'' of which the Legends size of "Less then 60 meters" comes from. The CGI model used in the film is slightly visually larger than two times the length of an AT-TE, rather than significantly larger as implied by the databank.<ref name="SPHA DB" /> The [[2018]] [[canon]] reference book, ''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia of Starfighters and Other Vehicles]]'' authored by [[Landry Q. Walker]], also establishes a length of 140.2 meters.<ref name="Starfighters" />
